intro: How I approach problems, in six projects.

studies.title: Gen AI Shift Report Agent
studies.metricLabel: less time spent on shift-handover summaries
studies.summary: A Copilot Studio agent that turns long end-of-shift reports into an actionable checklist.
studies.problem: Frontline operators wrote customisable end-of-shift reports to brief incoming crews. In complex plants these reports grew too long, turning shift meetings into report-reading sessions that ran for hours. Teams talked about what had happened instead of what needed attention.
studies.solution: A Power Automate workflow detects each new shift report. I built a Gen AI agent in Microsoft Copilot Studio that parses the report through built-in connectors and passes it to the agent. A Prompt tool, carrying my instructions, summarises the report into an actionable checklist, which integrated email connectors forward to users.
studies.outcome: I vibe-coded, with a lot of research, a clean working agent with three components: an agent flow, a prompt tool and an email connector. Its actionable summary cut shift-handover summary time by 60%.

studies.title: Enterprise Risk Visualisation Product
studies.metricLabel: potential savings per site per year
studies.summary: A fit-for-purpose DIY risk-visualisation solution to replace an expensive licensed tool.
studies.problem: The cost of the existing risk-visualisation solution was becoming prohibitive, and its licence was due to expire in 2028, which prompted the search for an alternative.
studies.solution: I researched how assets approached risk visualisation: some had a custom solution, while others relied on the licensed tool. Through a market scan, I identified the best risk tools available and benchmarked Shell's solutions against them. One recommendation was a DIY solution that assets could customise to their needs.
studies.outcome: With a product team, I designed and deployed a fit-for-purpose DIY solution and piloted it at one asset. I then demoed it to other interested assets and worked with them to scale the solution globally.

studies.title: Enterprise Data Integration
studies.summary: Consolidated views of critical operational data that had been locked in siloed systems.
studies.problem: Critical operational data from systems such as SAP and Sphera sat in silos, with no consolidated or customised views.
studies.solution: I built the end-to-end business case, from problem framing to solution validation and benefits tracking. I defined requirements across multiple systems and worked with product and vendor teams to deliver the integrations.
studies.outcome: Realised $500K in efficiency savings by automating critical process metrics and the related reporting across multiple assets.

studies.title: Enterprise Quality Platform
studies.summary: An ML-enabled platform that replaced offline quality tracking across four global centres.
studies.problem: Four globally distributed centres managed the quality of 500+ projects offline. When project volume doubled, the approach broke down and left gaps in quality governance.
studies.solution: I led a 15-member cross-functional product team to deliver an end-to-end, machine-learning-enabled platform across 8 releases and 20+ sprints. I architected the data integration layer connecting 10+ systems via APIs into a data warehouse, and helped design 35+ Power BI dashboards surfacing 200+ KPIs. I drove adoption end to end through demos, webcasts and executive walkthroughs.
studies.outcome: The platform let the Quality CoE track quality closely as project volume grew 4x and keep 40,000+ project stakeholders informed. Beyond diagnostic monitoring, its machine-learning models flagged projects likely to become risky.

studies.title: Enterprise App Ecosystem
studies.summary: Four enterprise apps, one of which became the most visited in a 150+ app ecosystem.
studies.problem: A digital ecosystem needed enterprise apps to serve 260K+ associates across corporate functions.
studies.solution: I owned the product lifecycle for four enterprise apps, from requirements elicitation and user stories through A/B testing, sign-off and deployment. Their APIs enabled 15+ downstream apps, improving adoption and driving a 30% increase in platform traffic. I also enabled 100+ conditional-logic surveys on an internally developed, data-secure survey app that replaced a popular third-party tool.
studies.outcome: Scaled the four apps to 260K+ associates, and one became the most visited in a 150+ app ecosystem.

studies.title: Enterprise Recruitment Platform
studies.summary: An online recruitment portal that replaced a slow, offline hiring process.
studies.problem: The firm ran recruitment offline, leading to long delays.
studies.solution: I worked with the core HR team to understand and document the end-to-end recruitment process, then drafted the functional specifications for an online recruitment portal. I worked with an in-house product team to launch it across the country.
studies.outcome: Time to onboard new recruits fell by 90%.
